(see 4318 Ma. pur̤a); e·ṯ aṇ edge of bank of stream or tank (or with 916 Ta. ēṟu); e·r ( obl. e·ṯ- ), in: te·lvie·r Pykara river (< te·l pey e·r), kime·r n.pr. of swamp at Kolme·l village. Tu.
